panel.definition: economies reported for both TypeScript and JavaScript in every quarter

figures.name: panel_economies
figures.description: Economies reported for both languages in every quarter (the fixed set).

figures.name: first_quarter
figures.description: The first quarter in the file.

figures.name: last_quarter
figures.description: The latest quarter in the file.

figures.name: prev_year_quarter
figures.description: The same quarter one year before the latest.

figures.name: first_year
figures.description: Calendar year of the first quarter.

figures.name: last_year
figures.description: Calendar year of the latest quarter.

figures.name: span_years
figures.description: Whole years from the first quarter to the latest (quarters / 4).

figures.name: ratio_first_pct
figures.description: Panel sum of language A pushers / panel sum of language B pushers x 100, first quarter.

figures.name: ratio_last_pct
figures.description: Panel sum of language A pushers / panel sum of language B pushers x 100, latest quarter.

figures.name: gap_first_millions
figures.description: Panel B pushers minus panel A pushers, first quarter, in millions.

figures.name: gap_last_millions
figures.description: Panel B pushers minus panel A pushers, latest quarter, in millions.

figures.name: a_growth_x
figures.description: Panel A pushers in the latest quarter / in the first quarter.

figures.name: b_growth_x
figures.description: Panel B pushers in the latest quarter / in the first quarter.

figures.name: top_n
figures.description: How many of the largest languages the growth comparison covers (spec parameter topN).

figures.name: fastest_top_language
figures.description: Of the topN languages by panel pushers in the latest quarter, the one with the largest growth multiple (each language summed over the panel economies reported for it at both ends).

figures.name: ratio_gain_last_pts
figures.description: Change in the A/B ratio (percent) over the latest year.

figures.name: ratio_gain_max_earlier_pts
figures.description: Largest change in the A/B ratio over any earlier year (same-quarter steps).

figures.name: median_ratio_first_pct
figures.description: Median over panel economies of A/B x 100, first quarter.

figures.name: median_ratio_last_pct
figures.description: Median over panel economies of A/B x 100, latest quarter.

figures.name: threshold_pct
figures.description: The ratio threshold the economy count uses (spec parameter thresholdPct).

figures.name: econ_at_threshold_first
figures.description: Panel economies whose A/B ratio is at or above the threshold, first quarter.

figures.name: econ_at_threshold_last
figures.description: Panel economies whose A/B ratio is at or above the threshold, latest quarter.

figures.name: max_ratio_last_pct
figures.description: Highest A/B ratio x 100 among panel economies, latest quarter.

figures.name: econ_reported_a_first
figures.description: Economies (all, not only the panel) reported for language A, first quarter.

figures.name: econ_reported_a_last
figures.description: Economies (all, not only the panel) reported for language A, latest quarter.

claims.name: ratio_rose
claims.statement: 'As a share of JavaScript, yes': the A/B ratio is higher at the end than at the start.

claims.name: gap_widened
claims.statement: 'in raw numbers, no: JavaScript's lead grew': B minus A is larger at the end than at the start.

claims.name: both_grew
claims.statement: 'because both languages grew' and 'grew ... over': both growth multiples exceed 1.

claims.name: fastest_is_a
claims.statement: The alt text pairs the fastest top language with A's multiple: they must be the same language.

claims.name: last_year_fastest
claims.statement: 'The ratio moved fastest in the last year': the latest yearly gain is the largest.

claims.name: no_earlier_gain_exceeds_spoken
claims.statement: 'in no earlier year did it rise more than X': the unrounded maximum is at most the spoken, rounded X.

claims.name: picture_same
claims.statement: 'Economy by economy, the picture is the same': the median economy's ratio also rose.

claims.name: threshold_up_from
claims.statement: 'up from X': more economies at the threshold at the end than at the start.

claims.name: reported_rose
claims.statement: 'the economies it reports for TypeScript rose': more reported at the end than at the start.

chartFigures.name: growth_bars.growth.html
chartFigures.description: HTML: pushers latest / first quarter, over panel economies reported for it at both ends.
chartFigures.code:
def _chart_growth_bars(an: Analysis, add) -> None:
    for lang in an.top_languages():
        multiple, n = an.growth(lang)
        add(f"growth_bars.growth.{slug(lang)}", "times_sign", multiple, 1,
            f"{lang}: pushers latest / first quarter, over panel economies reported for it at both ends.")
        add(f"growth_bars.economies.{slug(lang)}", "count", n, 0,
            f"{lang}: panel economies reported for it in both the first and the latest quarter.")
